sections.heading: Description
sections.content: Celebrating success informs and brings awareness about the progress of the project to build a positive attitude towards the change. It presents success in an appreciative way and praises the team on their commitment and support. Furthermore, it creates a positive attitude toward the change and recognizes individuals who have contributed towards successful implementation.

sections.heading: Business Value
sections.content: Improves employee motivation and satisfaction. Enhances engagement and commitment. Supports retention and cultural alignment. Reinforces transformation success and momentum. Builds a positive and resilient organizational culture.

sections.heading: Related Guidelines & Tools
items: Celebrate in presence or virtual — whatever is possible
Face-to-face congratulations by Sponsor or Manager
Communication of success stories in project or customer newsletter
